cover.title: Alderbank Logistics: refinancing case and covenant headroom
cover.sub: Senior secured term loan for a fictional regional logistics borrower.
cover.meta: As of quarter end · sample borrower · theme specimen

exec.title: Leverage is down to {lev} and every covenant passes with room to spare

rows.p: Terms match the base case. The tightest covenant still has {hr_min} headroom, and leverage falls every year of the plan.
A {tl} term loan and a {rcf} revolver, secured on all fleet and depot assets with a full guarantor package.
The top customer is {top} of revenue; fixed charge cover is the tightest test.

exec.callout: Decision requested: approve the {tl2} term loan on the terms in the credit agreement summary.
exec.source: Source: borrower compliance certificate and management accounts (fictional)
exec.note: Leverage falling is favourable, so its delta shows in green.

chart.title: Leverage falls below {thr} by FY27 in the base case and holds inside the covenant in the downside

bullets: Base: volume growth of {g} a year, margins flat.
Downside: loss of the top customer in FY26E.
takeaway.sowhat: Even losing the top customer leaves leverage under the limit.

chart.source: Source: lender model, base and downside cases (fictional)

table.title: All eight covenants pass, with three on watch below {watch_t} headroom
table.callout: Fixed charge cover is the test to watch: it has the least headroom and moves first if the top customer leaves.
table.source: Source: borrower compliance certificate (fictional); lender analysis
table.note: Headroom is the distance to the limit as a share of the limit (maximum tests) or of the current value (minimum tests). Watch below 15%.
